info.name: Palo Alto Networks Enterprise DLP API
info.description:
REST API for managing Enterprise Data Loss Prevention (DLP) through Palo Alto Networks cloud-delivered security services. Provides incident detection and management, data pattern configuration, and reporting capabilities for monitoring sensitive data exposure across network traffic, SaaS applications, and endpoints. Enables integration with SIEM, SOAR, and ticketing systems for automated incident response workflows. Requires an active Enterprise DLP subscription with SASE. Authentication uses OAuth 2.0 Bearer tokens from the SASE authentication framework.

Contact Support:
 Name: Palo Alto Networks Developer Support

item.name: Palo Alto Networks Get Incident Content Snippets

request.description: Returns content snippets showing the context around data pattern matches in the incident. Snippets provide visibility into the sensitive data that triggered the DLP policy without returning the full document or transaction content. Matched values are partially masked by default.

item.name: Palo Alto Networks List Data Patterns

query.description: Maximum number of patterns to return.

request.description: Returns a list of configured data patterns used for DLP detection. Includes both predefined system patterns (such as credit card numbers, social security numbers, and HIPAA identifiers) and custom patterns defined by the organization. Each pattern includes its detection rules, confidence thresholds, and associated data profile assignments.
